contacts.subject: Airline Empire: offline airline strategy for iOS — planned 16 October
contacts.body:
Hi Sune and the MiniReview team,

I'm Isac, the developer of Airline Empire: Flight Tycoon, planned for iPhone and iPad on 16 October 2026.

I'm reaching out because MiniReview helps players find mobile games by how they actually play. Airline Empire is about choosing routes, matching aircraft to demand, and keeping a growing network profitable. It plays offline, saves locally, and has no ads, energy system, or paid currency.

The free game includes one campaign, 20 nearby airports and two eras; optional Pro expands the campaign to 94 real airports and five eras.

Screenshots and a concise fact sheet: https://airline-empire-official.isacmolin.chatgpt.site/press.html

Best,
Isac Molin

contacts.subject: Upcoming iOS strategy game: Airline Empire targets 16 October
contacts.body:
Hi Pocket Gamer team,

I'm Isac, the developer of Airline Empire: Flight Tycoon, an airline management game planned for iPhone and iPad on 16 October 2026.

Players build an airline by opening routes, choosing aircraft and balancing fares, demand and operating costs. The campaign spans five aviation eras and 94 real airports with optional Pro. A free starting campaign includes 20 nearby airports and two eras.

It is designed for offline play with local saves, no account, no ads and no paid currency.

For your upcoming mobile games coverage, the fact sheet and downloadable screenshots are here: https://airline-empire-official.isacmolin.chatgpt.site/press.html
